description: Lore documentation factory — deterministic enforcement of BLOCKING DoD rules. Paths are resolved relative to the project root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR / payload cwd); JSON is parsed via jq → python3 → sed, warning loudly if none are available. check-image-path.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown or MDX referencing /static/img/, or any image written under docs/ (§6/Rule 1). check-frontmatter.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown/MDX missing valid frontmatter keys (§2/§6). verify-docs.sh (Stop) blocks (exit 2) images under docs/ and /static/img/ refs, and warns about orphan images; it honors stop_hook_active to avoid loops. Scope carve-out: .claude/**, templates/**, and _templates/** intentional examples are ignored.
